config.label: UniFi Site Manager API key with Network scope (unifi
config.description: UniFi Site Manager API key with Network scope (unifi.ui.com, Settings > API). It controls your whole network: treat it like an admin password.

config.label: Write confirmation: destructive tools return a preview and run only when called again with confirm "YES"
config.description: Write confirmation: destructive tools return a preview and run only when called again with confirm "YES". Only false, 0, no or off turn it off.

config.label: API base URL; this host receives the API key
config.description: API base URL; this host receives the API key. https origin only (http only for loopback test stubs). Keep the default.

config.label: Per-request timeout in milliseconds, covering response headers and body
config.description: Per-request timeout in milliseconds, covering response headers and body.

config.label: Log level on stderr: debug, info, warn or error
config.description: Log level on stderr: debug, info, warn or error.

config.label: Pins the UniFi console instead of discovering it (needed when the account has several consoles)
config.description: Pins the UniFi console instead of discovering it (needed when the account has several consoles).

config.label: Pins the Network site instead of discovering it
config.description: Pins the Network site instead of discovering it.

config.label: Pins the Site Manager site instead of discovering it
config.description: Pins the Site Manager site instead of discovering it.

config.label: Read-only mode: every write tool returns an error and sends no request; reads still work
config.description: Read-only mode: every write tool returns an error and sends no request; reads still work. Off by default.

config.label: Masks passwords, WiFi passphrases, pre-shared keys and other secret fields in every tool result with (redacted); write tools refuse a body that contains that placeholder
config.description: Masks passwords, WiFi passphrases, pre-shared keys and other secret fields in every tool result with (redacted); write tools refuse a body that contains that placeholder. Off by default.

config.label: Cuts tool results longer than this many bytes and marks them as truncated
config.description: Cuts tool results longer than this many bytes and marks them as truncated. Unset or empty: 100000. 0, off or none: no cap.
